backgroundImage.alt: Connected enterprise platforms and business operations

sections.heading: Odoo configured around your operating model
sections.body:
When spreadsheets and disconnected applications slow everyday work, start with the processes that need to connect. Linkfields plans an Odoo implementation around agreed accounting, inventory, sales and CRM requirements rather than customising everything.

The intended outcome is fewer manual hand-offs and clearer process ownership, validated against your acceptance criteria.
sections.secondaryBody: Agree modules, edition, hosting and upgrade responsibilities before configuration. Confirm market-specific accounting, localisation and integration requirements with your business owners; no universal compliance or total business-coverage claim is made. [Explore Intelligent Enterprise Platforms](/services/intelligent-enterprise-platforms).

sections.heading: Make expansion secure and upgrade-aware
sections.body:
Agree data owners, role permissions, approval controls and protected migration environments. Test changes against the chosen hosting and upgrade model, with business acceptance and a recovery plan before release.

[Quality engineering](/services/digital-transformation/quality-engineering), [Cyber Security](/services/cyber-security) and [delivery accelerators](/products-and-accelerators/delivery-accelerators) support the agreed controls. Local accounting requirements need business and professional validation, not a blanket platform claim.

sections.heading: Questions before you begin
sections.description: Bring your priority workflows, current tools and local requirements to plan a bounded first release.

items.title: Which Odoo modules and hosting options are included?
items.description: Scope is agreed against your processes, existing systems, edition, market and hosting requirements. Accounting, inventory, sales and CRM are process areas to assess, not a promise to implement every module or meet every local requirement.

items.title: Do we need bespoke development?
items.description: Begin with standard configuration. An extension needs a clear fit-gap, owner, acceptance criteria and assessment of upgrade and support impact; a Linkworks application can be considered where the requirement sits outside the ERP/CRM core.

items.title: What happens to existing data and systems?
items.description: Define what remains in place, what migrates and which system owns each record. Rehearse loads and agree mappings, cleansing, reconciliation and exception acceptance before cutover.

items.title: How do support and commercials work?
items.description: Time & Materials fits discovery; Fixed Price fits agreed scope and milestones. Managed Service or a Dedicated Team can support continuing change, with service boundaries and levels agreed in the contract. Outcome-Based terms require evidenced measures; software is available separately.
